title: Signing
none: Send the documents for signing, supervisors sign on their own page.
draft: The route is ready but not sent yet.

paused.rebuilt: The document changed after approval: the route is stopped.
paused.marks_changed: Signatures on the pages changed: the route is stopped.
paused.frozen_changed: The frozen PDF changed: the route is stopped.
paused.participant_left: A participant left the project: assign someone else and send again.
paused.returned: The route was returned for rework.

completed: Everyone has signed. You can build the package.

action.archiveHint: The route will stop watching the documents

confirm.title: Cancel the route?
confirm.text: Everyone who already got a request will be notified. Signatures already made stay.

toast.remindedEmail: Reminder sent by email and to the Inbox
toast.inviteCopied: Invitation link copied: send it yourself
toast.copyFailed: Could not copy: take the link below
toast.blocked: Cannot send: fix what is blocking it
toast.inboxCopied: Inbox link copied: the invitation is waiting for the person there

error.invalid_transition: The route has already changed. Refresh the page.
error.participant_not_waiting: It is not their turn now.
error.rate_limited: Too often. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
error.network: The server is unreachable. Check your connection.
error.link_by_mail: The invitation link is sent by email. Press “Remind” to send it again.

hold.banner: This document is out for signing (step {{step}} of {{total}}). Editing and rebuilding will stop the route.
hold.signatures: Signatures cannot be changed while the route is running.
hold.locked: This document is out for signing: signatures cannot be changed. To change them, cancel the route on the submission checkpoint page.

unsigned: The route is sent, your signature is not in place yet.
